title: Modulatory effects of cinnamomi cortex and its components epicatechin and linalool on skin circadian rhythms.
authors: Kim, Ji-Young; Lee, Juyeon; Lee, Soo-Hyeon; Jung, Eui-Man; Lee, Kyung-Ha
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肉桂提取物及其成分对皮肤昼夜节律的调节，涉及分子对接预测与RORA结合，但核心是皮肤生物学而非TF-DNA互作机制，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Circadian rhythms, intrinsic 24-h cycles regulating physiological processes, are crucial for skin homeostasis. Disruptions in these rhythms are linked to various skin disorders and impaired barrier function. Circadian rhythms can be modulated by botanical compounds, which hold therapeutic potential. However, the effect of cinnamomi cortex (CC), an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, on the circadian rhythm of keratinocytes remains unclear. This study aimed to examine the effects of CC extract and its 18 individual components on the circadian rhythm of HaCaT, an immortalized human keratinocyte line. CC extract and its bioactive components epicatechin (EC) and linalool (LO) significantly enhanced the circadian amplitude without altering the period. Gene expression analysis revealed that CC extract, EC, and LO altered the mRNA and protein levels of clock genes in a time-dependent manner. During molecular docking simulations, both EC and LO exhibited strong binding affinities for RORA, a key nuclear receptor involved in circadian regulation. Enhanced BMAL1 promoter activity following EC and LO treatments corroborated these findings. Furthermore, EC and LO demonstrated significant antioxidant activities, as evidenced by reduced reactive oxygen species levels and increased expression of antioxidant enzymes. EC and LO also upregulated skin barrier-related and ceramide synthesis genes and modulated the expression of cellular longevity-promoting genes. In conclusion, CC extract, particularly the components EC and LO, modulated circadian rhythms, reduced oxidative stress, and enhanced skin barrier function in keratinocytes. These findings highlight the potential of CC extract and its components as novel dermatological treatments to improve skin health and combat aging.
abstract_zh: 昼夜节律是调节生理过程的内在24小时周期，对皮肤稳态至关重要。这些节律的紊乱与多种皮肤疾病及屏障功能受损相关。昼夜节律可被植物化合物调节，这些化合物具有治疗潜力。然而，肉桂皮 (cinnamomi cortex, CC)——一种具有抗炎、抗氧化和抗菌作用的物质——对角质形成细胞昼夜节律的影响仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨CC提取物及其18种单一成分对永生化人角质形成细胞系HaCaT昼夜节律的影响。CC提取物及其生物活性成分表儿茶素 (epicatechin, EC) 和芳樟醇 (linalool, LO) 显著增强昼夜节律振幅，而不改变周期。基因表达分析显示，CC提取物、EC和LO以时间依赖性方式改变时钟基因的mRNA和蛋白水平。在分子对接模拟中，EC和LO均对RORA——一种参与昼夜节律调节的关键核受体——表现出强结合亲和力。EC和LO处理后BMAL1启动子活性增强，进一步证实了这些发现。此外，EC和LO表现出显著的抗氧化活性，表现为活性氧水平降低和抗氧化酶表达增加。EC和LO还上调皮肤屏障相关及神经酰胺合成基因，并调节细胞长寿促进基因的表达。总之，CC提取物，特别是其成分EC和LO，调节角质形成细胞的昼夜节律、减少氧化应激并增强皮肤屏障功能。这些发现凸显了CC提取物及其成分作为新型皮肤病治疗手段以改善皮肤健康和对抗衰老的潜力。
